about: Labelled statement PAIRS for the contradiction detector. Built after FINDING-1 measured 73,500 contradiction edges from 300 facts, nearly all of them false. Precision is the metric that matters here; the detector's recall was never in doubt.
limitations: SYNTHETIC. Written to characterise a KNOWN failure, so the per-item-table category is deliberately over-represented relative to real traffic — it is the class that fires.

PAIRS, not corpora. The real detector also gates on cross-FILE provenance, which a pair cannot express. A fix that only tightened the file rule would score identically here and still help in production — this dataset measures the TEXTUAL predicate only.
A 'genuine' label means the two statements cannot both be true. It does NOT mean the detector should always surface them — surfacing policy is a separate decision from detection.
